description.zh: 猎人在 Beta 中的练级加点路线与逐点顺序。
description.en: Level-by-level Hunter talent orders in the Forever beta.

body.zh: 【野兽控制 Beta 开荒】先拿致命守护触发 30% 远程攻速，再补移动速度，以及复活更快、跟得上你的宠物。 【射击 Beta 开荒】11 点全部投入射击系直取独来独往：不召唤宠物时伤害提高 20%，另有暴击与智力转攻强加成。
body.en: [Beast Mastery Beta Start] Deadly Aspects for a 30% ranged attack speed proc, then movement speed and a pet that revives fast and keeps up with you. [Marksmanship Beta Start] Eleven points straight down Marksmanship for Lone Wolf: 20% more damage while no pet is active, on top of crit and Attack Power from Intellect.

body.zh: 以上方案来自 Beta 版本 1.60.1.70425 的公开数据整理，正式版本上线后可能需要重新验证。
body.en: These builds come from published data for beta build 1.60.1.70425 and may need re-verification at launch.
